name: cobol-exec-unterminated-block-scan
body: past_block skips an EXEC block to the next END-EXEC anywhere later in the procedure division when it looks for the sentence period, so a block whose END-EXEC is missing reports its diagnostic but the period scan can swallow following sentences up to a later block's END-EXEC. Limit: one unterminated EXEC block can hide the statements after it. Upgrade by bounding the search at the next paragraph or section header or END PROGRAM when a corpus shows unterminated blocks.
